title: A View of the Mountain Pass Called the Notch of the White Mountains (Crawford Notch)
rights: NGA object page marks this media free and public domain; NGA Open Access policy releases qualifying images under CC0.
courtesy: Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington
adaptations: Sky matte follows painted mountain/ridges and preserves foreground branches.
Clear sky clone texture comes from the original upper-right painted sky; moving cloud texture comes from its incoming upper-left clouds.
Night uses conventional brightness/saturation and cool color grading; no invented stars, lights or buildings.
Snow uses terrain/roof/branch masks and original luminance texture; rider region excluded from broad ground coating.
Source JPEG is retained unchanged; no generative image model was used.

integrationNotes: Six selected WebP derivatives copied unchanged; source JPEG remains in isolated review evidence.
Production shell uses the approved 50% 52% cover camera and maximum stage aspect2.1; ordinary app scrolling reveals lower artwork in wide/shallow windows. Mobile retains full painting.
Registered masked clouds and synthetic visible-sky illumination; no observed strike, chimney, lights or blizzard is asserted.
Cards retain their existing fills, content, typography, transforms and controls; bounded artwork appears only on a narrow decorative rim.
Small-screen credit is an app-scrollport footer; desktop credit is offset past the sidebar. No control is covered by the small-screen credit.
